metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use PRISM monthly precipitation (OREGONSTATE/PRISM/AN81m) for 2018 over the District of Columbia county polygon (TIGER/2018/Counties). If empty, fallback to CHIRPS daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for 2018. 2. Masking strategy: Precipitation products are not impacted by clouds like optical imagery, so no cloud masking; count valid pixels via Reducer.count. 3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count after processing is 0 -> C2. If result is null or unreasonable (<0 or >10000 mm) -> C3. Threshold: 50 inches = 1270 mm. Compare annual mean depth over DC; if >=1270 mm -> A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const start = '2018-01-01'; const end = '2019-01-01'; const dcFeat = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Counties') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'District of Columbia')) .first(); const dcGeom = ee.Feature(dcFeat).geometry().buffer(0); // Helper to getInfo as Promise const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback let dataset = 'PRISM'; let bandName = 'ppt'; let scale = 4000; let col = ee.ImageCollection('OREGONSTATE/PRISM/AN81m') .filterDate(start, end) .select(['ppt']); let size = await getInfo(col.size()); console.log(`Primary Dataset: PRISM monthly ppt`); console.log(`2018 Images (PRISM): ${size}`); if (!size || size === 0) { // Fallback to CHIRPS daily dataset = 'CHIRPS'; bandName = 'precipitation'; scale = 5000; col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(start, end) .select([bandName]); size = await getInfo(col.size()); console.log(`Fallback Dataset: CHIRPS daily`); console.log(`2018 Images (CHIRPS): ${size}`); if (!size || size === 0) { console.log('No images available for 2018 in both datasets.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing: Sum precipitation over the year const annualSum = col.sum().rename(bandName); // mm over 2018 // Valid pixel count const pixCountDict = await getInfo( annualSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dcGeom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true, }) ); const validPixels = pixCountDict ? pixCountDict[bandName] : null; console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validPixels}`); if (!validPixels || validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation: Area-mean annual precipitation in mm const meanDict = await getInfo( annualSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dcGeom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true, }) ); const annualMm = meanDict ? meanDict[bandName] : null; if (annualMm === null || annualMm === undefined || isNaN(annualMm) || annualMm < 0 || annualMm > 10000) { console.log(`Annual precip mm invalid: ${annualMm}`); console.log('C3'); return; } const annualIn = annualMm / 25.4; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`); console.log(`Annual Precip (mm): ${annualMm.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Annual Precip (in): ${annualIn.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Threshold (in): 50.00`); if (annualIn >= 50) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
